result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals despite being controlled by traffic lights. The wide, unmarked roadway and narrow sidewalks with utility pole obstructions create a hostile environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Absence of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.
hazards.location_in_image: Across both 5th St and Godfrey Ave at the intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to interpret vehicle signals which may not provide adequate crossing time.
hazards.location_in_image: Mounted on the traffic signal mast arms.

hazards.name: Sidewalk obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are located directly in the path of the narrow sidewalk, creating barriers for accessibility.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the left and right sidewalks.

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental or ladder-style crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Add Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

interventions.title: Implement Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and signalized crossings. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions or medians increase pedestrian exposure to vehicles.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic and parking without a median refuge or curb extensions to shorten the distance.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The existing parallel-line crosswalk markings are somewhat faded, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing markings to a continental or ladder pattern to increase visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide four-lane roadway with overhead traffic signals but lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While sidewalks are present on both sides, the environment prioritizes vehicular throughput over pedestrian safety and connectivity.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated path.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the intersection of Godfrey Av

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median refuge island, increasing exposure time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time relative to the traffic light cycle.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians at the corners.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide roadway with marked zebra crosswalks and traffic signals, including 'No Turn on Red' restrictions. However, the lack of a median refuge and the significant crossing distance increase pedestrian exposure to vehicular traffic.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without a protected space.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian refuge
hazards.description: There is no median or island to provide safety for pedestrians who may not finish crossing in one cycle.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to shorten the crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area mid-crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.
